name: FGVR_MLLM_Benchmark
description: FGVR_MLLM_Benchmark evaluates multimodal large language models on fine-grained visual reasoning and understanding tasks that require precise grounding in image content. It contains image-question pairs that probe detailed object attributes, relations, and compositional reasoning beyond coarse scene-level answers. The benchmark measures models' ability to produce correct, well-grounded answers to visually grounded queries.
reputation: A niche but growing benchmark used by researchers evaluating fine-grained visual reasoning in MLLMs; modest adoption so far.
